statement: Among normalized C3-free 13-sets of span at most 63, there are exactly 6 sets in 4 reflection orbits; exact span counts are {'60': 1, '61': 0, '62': 1, '63': 4}, every span-60 and span-62 birth is reflection-symmetric as recorded by {'60': 1, '61': 0, '62': 1, '63': 0}, and every set is at replacement distance at most 7 from the unique span-60 birth orbit.
singleExchangeRepairBoundary: The unique birth is isolated in the one-element-exchange graph, so a universal monotone single-exchange repair theorem is false even in this shell.
